_comment: The game's music cues (audio.js setMusic names) and the brief each loop is checked against by render.mjs and qa.py. loopSeconds: loop length range; bpm: quarter notes per minute; contrastLU: [min, max] LU between the quietest and the loudest 4 bars (qa.py warns outside it: a heuristic, not a rule).

title.brief: Title screen and menus. Majestic, lyrical, a little ominous: the pass at dawn, 300 against an empire.

battle.brief: Days 1-2 fighting and respites. Driving, epic, martial; exciting yet not fatiguing over 20+ minutes (A/B/C sections, a breath before the build).

lastStand.brief: Day 3 on the Kolonos after Leonidas falls. Heroic lament: grief and defiance, building.
